principalMessage.title: Welcome from the Principal
principalMessage.name: Prof. Dr. Mohammad Rafiqul Islam
principalMessage.designation: Principal & Head of Institution (M.Sc, M.Ed, Ph.D)
principalMessage.quote: Education is not merely the transmission of facts, but the ignition of curiosity, character, and empathy in young minds.
principalMessage.content:
It gives me immense pride to welcome you to E-Biddalay Model High School & College. Over the past three decades, our institution has stood as a beacon of academic rigor, disciplined ethos, and progressive pedagogical innovation in Dhaka.

Here, we believe that every student possesses unique talents waiting to be unleashed. Our distinguished educators combine rigorous academic curricula with vibrant co-curricular pursuits—including science fairs, coding clubs, debating society, and championship athletics. We maintain strong partnerships with parents and guardians to build a compassionate, forward-looking learning community.

I invite you to explore our campus, witness our student achievements, and partner with us in shaping the leaders of tomorrow.

about.history: Founded in 1995 by a group of dedicated educationists and visionaries in Dhanmondi, Dhaka, E-Biddalay Model High School & College commenced its journey with 120 students and 8 teachers. Over three decades of steadfast commitment, the institution expanded into a premier multi-storied campus serving over 1,800 students from primary to higher secondary college levels. Our alumni hold distinguished positions across medicine, engineering, civil service, global academia, and enterprise worldwide.

historyMilestones.title: Foundation & Inception
historyMilestones.description: Established as an English & National Curriculum primary and junior secondary institution.

historyMilestones.title: Secondary School Certification (SSC)
historyMilestones.description: Recognized by Dhaka Education Board with 100% first-batch first-division pass.

historyMilestones.title: College Level Expansion (HSC)
historyMilestones.description: Inauguration of Higher Secondary College section offering Science, Humanities, and Business Studies.

historyMilestones.title: Smart Campus & STEM Lab
historyMilestones.description: Launch of multimedia smart classrooms, modern robotics laboratory, and automated student management system.

historyMilestones.title: National Academic Excellence Award
historyMilestones.description: Awarded top academic institution honor for outstanding GPA-5.00 pass rate and digital governance.

about.mission: To impart holistic, modern, and value-based education that equips students with critical thinking, scientific competence, moral integrity, and social responsibility.
about.vision: To be recognized as a world-class academic center of excellence that empowers young men and women to lead positive change in Bangladesh and the global society.
objectives: Foster independent thinking, intellectual curiosity, and scientific inquiry through interactive learning.
Achieve top-tier performance in national board examinations (SSC and HSC) with consistent 100% pass rates.
Instill ethical values, mutual respect, patriotism, and global citizenship.
Provide vibrant sports, debate, cultural, and community service programs alongside core academics.
Integrate modern digital tools, coding, and multimedia technology across every classroom.

facilities.title: Smart Multimedia Classrooms
facilities.description: Spacious, climate-controlled classrooms equipped with high-definition digital projectors, interactive smartboards, and ergonomic furniture.

facilities.title: Advanced Science Laboratories
facilities.description: Separate, state-of-the-art physics, chemistry, and biology labs designed according to board standards with specialized demonstration stations.

facilities.title: High-Tech Computer & Robotics Lab
facilities.description: 60+ networked workstations with high-speed internet, programming software, IoT kits, and robotics kits for hands-on IT literacy.

facilities.title: Central Digital Library
facilities.description: A quiet reading sanctuary housing over 15,000 reference books, national journals, competitive exam resources, and an e-book terminal.

facilities.title: Sports Complex & Playground
facilities.description: Outdoor grounds for football, cricket, and athletics, alongside indoor spaces for table tennis, chess, and badminton training.

facilities.title: Auditorium & Cultural Hall
facilities.description: A 600-seat acoustic auditorium for annual cultural programs, science symposiums, national debate competitions, and assemblies.

about.achievementsSummary: Over the last 5 years, 100% of our SSC and HSC candidates passed with distinction, with over 78% securing GPA-5.00. Our students have won 1st prize in the National Science Olympiad and represented Bangladesh in international debates.

notices.title: Annual Examination 2026 Routine & Examination Guidelines
notices.content: The official schedule for the upcoming Annual Examination 2026 has been published. All students are instructed to collect their admit cards from the class teacher by November 5. No electronic gadgets or unauthorized stationery are permitted inside the examination hall.

notices.title: Admissions Open for Class 1 to Class 9 & Class 11 (Session 2026-2027)
notices.content: Application forms for new admissions in the upcoming academic session are now available online and at the accounts counter. The online admission portal will remain active until November 30. Merit test dates will be notified via SMS.

notices.title: Half-Yearly Marksheets and Tabulation Summaries Available
notices.content: Parents and guardians are requested to review the verified Half-Yearly examination marksheets on the student portal or by using the public result verification tool with the student roll number.

notices.title: Inter-House Annual Sports & Athletics Meet 2026 Schedule
notices.content: The 31st Annual Sports Meet will be held on the school playground from November 12 to November 14. House captains and interested participants must submit registration slips to the Physical Education department.

notices.title: Science Fair & Robotics Project Exhibition Registration
notices.content: All students of Class 6 to Class 10 and College section are invited to register team projects for the upcoming Annual Science Fest. Prototype categories include Green Energy, AI & Automation, and Environmental Science.

newsArticles.title: Grand Annual Science, Robotics & Innovation Fair 2026 Concludes
newsArticles.summary: Over 85 student projects were showcased, featuring automatic solar irrigators, AI emergency detectors, and clean energy prototypes.
newsArticles.content: The three-day Annual Science & Robotics Expo concluded yesterday amidst enthusiastic participation from parents, distinguished university scientists, and over 1,500 visitors. Prof. Dr. Mohammad Rafiqul Islam commended the students for their ingenious engineering prototypes, stating that early STEM inquiry is the cornerstone of sustainable nation-building.

newsArticles.title: National Victory Day Cultural Symposium & Art Competition
newsArticles.summary: Commemorating our national heritage through patriotic songs, speech competitions, and canvas exhibitions.
newsArticles.content: Our institution will host a solemn and colorful Victory Day cultural ceremony on December 16. The program features patriotic poetry recitation, historical documentary screenings, and an inter-class art exhibition celebrating our liberation history.

newsArticles.title: Parent-Teacher Conference & Academic Counseling Session Held
newsArticles.summary: Constructive dialogue on individual student progress, continuous evaluation, and mental wellness strategies.
newsArticles.content: Over 1,200 parents joined our faculty members last Saturday for the semesterly Parent-Teacher Conference. Discussions focused on personalized academic coaching, board exam preparations, and the balanced integration of extracurricular activities with study routines.
